operations.feature_evidence: Official dedicated operation page. No runtime edition or entitlement inference.

sensitivity.review: Identity, contact, invitation and organizational data remain native output; diagnostics must not echo input values.
sensitivity.extension_fields: No authentication secret delivery is declared. Treat identity and organizational fields as private data.

notes: Alternative addressing operation, not same-route duplicate. project_key case-insensitive/uppercase-matched; path idp_group_name exact match. Both keys required. Only project-scoped mappings addressable; all_projects:true must use mapping ID. Missing project or group mapping returns 404. Empty body 400 {"error":"Request body cannot be empty."}. Body idp_group_name can rename separately from path key.
Family overview says all endpoints workspace-scoped and require workspace admin permissions, in addition to operation named scope.
